m. (-ण्डः)
A jackal.
E.
फे imitative sound, रम to sport, aff. ड.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat.
2 Malicious, noxious, injurious.
m. (-वः)
1 A jackal or shacal.
2 A demon, a goblin.
E.
फे imitative sound, रु to utter, aff. अप्.

m. (-रुः)
A jackal.
E.
फे imitative sound, रु to cry, aff. डु.
